title: Thymosin β4 \(Tβ4)-induced outgrowth and differentiation of vasculogenic precursor cells from adult epicardium
protocol: Coat 6-well plates with gelatin by pipetting 2 ml of 0.1% gelatin solution and allowing it to stand for 15 minutes before aspirating.
Optional: Place coverslips into wells prior to gelatin coating.
Cull adult mouse by cervical dislocation.
Using sterile forceps and scissors, make a lateral incision in the center of the abdomen and tear back the fur to expose the rib cage.
Carefully cut upwards through the sternum and along the diaphragm, taking care not to cut into the heart. Pull back the ribs to reveal the heart.
Remove the heart using forceps and dissect away the atria and major vessels to leave right and left ventricles.

Place tissue in a 60mm tissue culture dish containing 2 ml of DPBS. Cut into quarters and allow blood to rinse from the tissue. Carefully aspirate away DPBS. Using a sterile scalpel, cut the heart into pieces of approximately 1 mm³.
Divide heart pieces into four equal portions.
Pipette 2 ml of EPDC culture medium supplemented with 100 ng/ml Tβ4 into each well to be used.
Place 1 portion of heart tissue into the centre of each well and ensure all pieces are submerged.
Gently transfer the plate to a humidified 5% CO₂ 37°C incubator.
Maintain cultures with minimal disturbance for the first 72 hours.
After 72 hours in culture, carefully transfer the plate to the culture hood.
Wash explants gently with DPBS.
Add 2 ml fresh EPDC medium containing 100 ng/ml Tβ4.
Leave for an additional 24 hours before assessing cellular phenotype.
Culture adult heart explants as described above.
After 72 hours of culture, fix cells with 4% PFA for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Block non-specific binding by incubating cells in BLOCK (1% BSA/10% sheep serum in PBS) for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate cells with an appropriate dilution of primary antibody (epicardin, 1:100; SMalphaA, 1:700; Flk1, 1:100), or Procollagen type I, 1:100) in BLOCK.
Wash cells 3 times using BLOCK.

Incubate cells with the appropriate secondary antibody (epicardin: Cy3-conjugated anti-rabbit; SMalphaA: FITC-conjugated anti-mouse, 1:30; Procollagen type I: Alexa 488-conjugated anti-goat, 1:200; Flk1: Alexa 594-conjugated anti-rat, 1:200) diluted in BLOCK.
Wash cells twice in PBS.
OPTIONAL: To stain nuclei, incubate with 5ug/ml Hoechst in PBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash cells twice in PBS.
Mount coverslips onto microscope slides using 50% glycerol in PBS as mountant and visualize using a fluorescence microscope.
